agent_descriptions.name: Name for the spawned agent. Makes it addressable via SendMessage({to: name}) while running.
agent_descriptions.team_name: Deprecated; ignored. The session has a single implicit team.
agent_descriptions.mode: Deprecated; ignored. Subagents inherit the parent session's permission mode; agent-definition frontmatter may override it.
agent_descriptions.run_in_background: Agents run in the background by default; you will be notified when one completes. Set to false only when your very next action depends on this agent's result and nothing else could usefully happen while it runs — otherwise leave it in the background so the user can hand you other work.

agent_errors: Teammates cannot spawn other teammates — the team roster is flat. To spawn a subagent instead, omit the `name` parameter.
In-process teammates cannot spawn background agents. Use run_in_background=false for synchronous subagents.
